description: This file defines the ProductViewed class, which manages the reporting of product view counts in an OpenCart extension. It includes methods for installing/uninstalling the database table, adding report data, retrieving viewed products, calculating totals, and clearing data.

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: Model class for managing product view reports in the database.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'product_viewed' table if it does not exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'product_viewed' table if it exists.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Inserts or updates view count for a specific product.

methods.name: getViewed
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products ordered by view count, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalViewed
methods.description: Returns the total number of view records.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the sum of views across all products.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the 'product_viewed' table, removing all records.
